headline: CNN 대조에서 개선 관측, best021 채택 기준 미달
decision_code_scope: reject_fixed_CE_hypothesis_keep_best021 means failure of the preregistered best021 integration/promotion hypothesis, not proof that CE cannot improve the standalone CNN.
evidence: True CE standalone improves detach by0.3073196901 and shuffled by0.2957519906 RMSE, both4/5fold.
True CE fixed10%blend improves paired detach by0.0320407921 and shuffled by0.0246857381, both4/5fold.
All four paired conditional95%CIs contain zero; top5removed gains remain positive. No statistically secure or independent generalization claim.
Against best021, true CE blend worsens0.0070245751 with2/5positivefolds; CI[-0.0875905665,0.0716938150], top5removed gain-0.0477488130.
Pooled training RMSE nearly unchanged: detach9.8856852,true9.8817703,shuffled9.6562942. Training fit alone does not explain OOF result.
methodological_limits: Only one fixed base seed per fold and reused400 development images.
Permuted-label auxiliary changes target informativeness and optimization difficulty/gradient distribution; cannot perfectly isolate regularization.
No global gradient clipping contamination: main and auxiliary separately clipped and optimized; exact plain-regression/detach update audits passed.
next_action: Report193 only; no coefficient/seed/epoch/blend search, resplits, full500, test or submission. Pooling remains officialformula-verification pending.
